scope.description: Comparison of all completed 30-epoch layer-reduction experiments.

selection_policy.why: Validation data is appropriate for model selection; the test set is reserved for final reporting.
selection_policy.test_set_role: Reported for transparency, not used for ranking.
selection_policy.stability_gate: Final recommendation excludes numerically unstable runs.

parameter_accounting.important_interpretation: Every layer-selection run has the same trainable downstream parameter count. selected_transformer_layers selects cached embeddings; it does not prune or skip WavLM encoder blocks. Input size and pooling/projector operations fall as layers are dropped.

all_layer_ncmtl.description: All 25 cached transformer-layer representations with the same NCMTL soft-row-sharing setup.

original_wavcse_reference.description: Original wavCSE result supplied in the experiment table; validation, overall test accuracy, and test loss were not supplied.
original_wavcse_reference.comparison_scope: Downstream network only; excludes the upstream WavLM encoder.

optimization_stability.stability_rule: No non-finite loss and no train/validation loss above 100 after epoch 5.
